abstract: Europe PMC (https://europepmc.org/) is an open access database of life-science literature that delivers open science to a wide audience through an open web interface, APIs, and bulk downloads. It brings together 48 million abstracts, 12 million full text published articles, and supplementary files and 1.2 million preprints, 76 000 of them full text, and makes them findable through dozens of search axes. Europe PMC is supported by 35 European and international funders to deliver a global open infrastructure and support their open access policies and metrics analysis. Europe PMC enriches the literature with 2 billion text-mined annotations, and links to dozens of biological databases. New developments to the Europe PMC platform since the last database update in 2023 include: (i) harnessing AI to enhance discovery through new machine learning generated annotations and working towards Europe PMC as a knowledge layer for LLMs; (ii) enhancing product development UX/UI capabilities, showcased through a new advanced search; (iii) improving literature discovery by text mining supplementary files; (iv) improving persistent identifier coverage and expanding the citation network.
